title: 15-page fan comic artist collab/pitch
content:

Chucky, Jason Voorhees, Freddy Krueger, Samara, and Lubden are forced into missions against threats too horrific for conventional forces.

But controlling monsters is impossible.

To stop Hell from unleashing… they’ve got to unleash hell.
